results.title: I Was Born This Way
results.overview: Surviving childhood abuse during his upbringing in Baltimore, Archbishop Carl Bean forged a path to New York and Hollywood to do the one thing he knew he was put on earth to do: sing. Making his mark first as a gospel singer, Bean got the break of his life when Motown tapped him in 1977 to record the disco song “I Was Born This Way,” which quickly became the first gay anthem at a time when it was uncommon to be out and proud. When the AIDS crisis hit, however, Bean soon found himself drawn to a different calling: compassionate activism. Instead of pursuing the momentum of his promising music career, he founded the Minority AIDS Project and the Unity Fellowship Church — the first LGBTQ+ church for people of color.

results.title: Last Soirée
results.overview: The FBI's very best touches down in Brixton to investigate the murder of a teenage girl. The clues surrounding the murder lead his investigation to London's most famous cinema, the Ritzy.

results.title: Romantic Killer
results.original_title: ロマンティック・キラー
results.overview: A gaming-obsessed teen must reignite romance energy for a fading magic realm by dating within a month. Forced into proximity with three charming suitors, will she dodge love's chaos—or embrace unexpected heartbeats to reclaim her mundane life?

results.title: Amelia, Amelia
results.overview: Amelia, a 12-year-old Chinese-Indonesian girl, has just learned of a tradition that says women who have received their period must not wash their underwear together with men's clothes, or the men will face bad luck.

results.title: Jean & I
results.overview: Michelle, a 10-year-old survivor of the 2010 Haiti earthquake, attempts to escape both her past and her new home when she learns that her "new" family is not what they seem.

results.title: No Way Back
results.overview: After years of toxic relationship with Joachim, Laura is raising their daughter on her own. Joachim's new partner, Shirine, shows up at Laura's door in trouble. Laura realizes that they are both under the same harmful influence. The two women try to help each other find a path out of the toxic relationship.

results.title: Evidence of the Boogeyman
results.overview: What started as a fun ghost hunt becomes a fight for survival when an indie film crew's footage proves the Boogeyman legend is terrifyingly real.

results.title: Things to Worry About
results.overview: A mother's love is put to the test when her 13-year-old son changes into someone she can no longer recognize. Will she accept the stranger he has become, or fight to reclaim the boy she once knew?

results.title: Just Sami
results.overview: Helsinki museum aide Sami idolizes visiting art star Camilo Delgado, but a night of volatile connection pushes him toward truths about ambition, devotion, and the dangerous light that powers genius.

results.title: Christa Funk: First In, Last Out
results.original_title: Christa Funk: First In, Last Out
results.overview: While in the Coast Guard in Hawaii, Christa Funk discovered surf photography. Inspired by her late father, she’s pushed herself into wild lineups to capture the ocean through her unique perspective.

results.title: The Beatles - Free As A Bird: A Song Reborn
results.original_title: The Beatles - Free As A Bird: A Song Reborn
results.overview: “A Song Reborn” reveals the extraordinary 1994 reunion of Paul, George and Ringo, 24 years after The Beatles parted ways. A true collaboration became possible when Yoko Ono handed them an unfinished John Lennon composition. Crafted from never-before-seen studio footage, this short film captures the three Beatles rediscovering their bond as they shape John’s song into the GRAMMY-winning “Free As A Bird.”

results.title: Theater Kid
results.overview: Theater Kid is a musical drama which focuses on the relationship between Kenneth and Jane, the two leads of their high school's upcoming winter musical.

results.title: Star People
results.overview: A photographer receives a tip that could finally shed some light on her childhood UFO sighting. But a deadly heat wave and unexpected guests threaten to derail her obsessive search for answers.

results.title: The Promise
results.overview: A forgotten struggle, a lost future. In the 1960s, an independent Papua seemed within reach. But international interests, geopolitical power struggles, and economic motives dictated otherwise. Using uniquely restored 35mm archival footage, The Promise brings this history to life, revealing how an entire people was systematically betrayed and oppressed.
